        neg = ops.neg(to_dtype_1)
        exp = ops.exp(neg)
        constant = ops.constant(1.0, torch.float32)
        add = ops.add(exp, constant)
        truediv = ops.truediv(to_dtype, add)
        to_dtype_2 = ops.to_dtype(truediv, torch.bfloat16, src_dtype = torch.float32, use_compute_types = True)
        get_index_2 = self.get_index('index0')
        load_2 = ops.load('buf38', get_index_2)
        mul = ops.mul(to_dtype_2, load_2)
        get_index_3 = self.get_index('index0')
        store = ops.store('buf39', get_index_3, mul, None)
        return store
